mission: M3DX - Hand landmark detector source feasibility

summary.finding: Public hand keypoint datasets with manual or human-in-loop labels exist, but none are approved in the repo source register and actual label use would require explicit human source/license/data-import approval. MediaPipe/generated-label routes remain disallowed for the promoted lane.
summary.detector0_relation_reason: Hand landmarks could become a future scratch localization and crop-normalization signal after source approval, but the current Detector 0 blocker is still presence/objectness formulation and crop-inclusion evidence. This source feasibility result does not supersede the local Detector 0 objectness repair route.

source_candidates.name: CMU Panoptic HandDB / Simon et al. 2017 manual hand keypoint annotations
source_candidates.approximate_size: 1912 training annotations and 846 testing annotations on the official HandDB manual partition
source_candidates.split_shape: official page separates manual train/test from synthetic and Panoptic multiview-bootstrapped partitions
source_candidates.label_schema: 2D hand keypoints, 21 landmarks per hand according to the Simon et al. hand keypoint dataset documentation and Voxel51 mirror card
license_rights_notes: Official HandDB page did not expose a separate license block in the fetched section.
Official CMU Panoptic root states Panoptic data is for research purposes only, cannot be used commercially, and cannot be redistributed without organizer permission.
Manual partition includes source images from MPII and NZSL according to the Voxel51 card, so underlying source licenses also require review.
source_candidates.labels_accessibility_notes: The official page describes partitions and download sizes but actual label files would require a dataset download/import that this mission did not perform.
disallowed_or_research_only_subsets: Panoptic multiview-bootstrapped partition until explicitly approved
source_candidates.rationale: This is the strongest lead for a strict scratch route because a manual 2D keypoint partition exists and is separated from generated or bootstrapped annotations.

source_candidates.name: Voxel51/hand-keypoints
source_candidates.approximate_size: 847 Dataset Viewer rows; card describes 846 samples and original Simon et al. manual dataset of 2800 hands
source_candidates.split_shape: Hugging Face Dataset Viewer exposes one default/train split; card describes original 2000-hand train and 800-hand test split from the paper/source dataset
source_candidates.label_schema: Card claims FiftyOne sample fields left_hand, right_hand, and body keypoints; Dataset Viewer first rows expose only image.
license_rights_notes: Card says source images include MPII Human Pose under BSD and New Zealand Sign Language Dictionary under CC BY-NC-SA 3.0.
Card is a mirror/repackaging, not the primary rights authority for this repo.
source_candidates.labels_accessibility_notes: Dataset Viewer metadata showed only one image feature and no keypoint columns, so this source cannot be treated as label-accessible through read-only viewer metadata.
disallowed_or_research_only_subsets: HF viewer image-only parquet path for training labels
source_candidates.rationale: Useful to confirm a manual-label lead and source licenses, but not enough to approve or consume labels in the promoted lane.

source_candidates.name: FreiHAND
source_candidates.split_shape: training set with 32560 unique samples post-processed in 4 ways; evaluation split separately released, with evaluation annotations now publicly available on the dataset page
source_candidates.label_schema: 3D keypoint annotation for 21 hand keypoints, hand segmentation mask, camera intrinsics, hand scale, and 3D shape annotation
license_rights_notes: Official project describes an iterative semi-automated human-in-the-loop annotation process with hand fitting optimization.
Official dataset page says research purposes only, no warranty, and commercial use prohibited.
3D shape/MANO-style outputs and optimization-derived labels require policy review before any promoted-lane use.
source_candidates.labels_accessibility_notes: The page describes what each sample provides, but actual labels require dataset download/import.
disallowed_or_research_only_subsets: any optimization-derived labels if treated as generated labels by policy review
source_candidates.rationale: Technically useful and large, but the human-in-loop plus optimization provenance must be reviewed against the no-generated-label rule.

source_candidates.name: InterHand2.6M
source_candidates.approximate_size: 5 fps release totals 2590347 frames; Train(H) has 528482 frames and Test(H) has 121573 frames
source_candidates.split_shape: official page separates Train(H), Train(M), Train(H+M), Val(M), Test(H), Test(M), and Test(H+M); H is the only clearly human-annotated candidate class for this repo
source_candidates.label_schema: COCO-style image and annotation JSON includes bbox, joint_valid, hand_type, hand_type_valid; joint_3d JSON includes world_coord and joint_valid; skeleton and subject files describe keypoint hierarchy and subjects
license_rights_notes: Official page describes download structure and annotation IDs but does not itself grant repo source approval.
M partitions and NeuralAnnot/MANO fits are not acceptable for promoted-lane labels without explicit provenance and policy approval.
Large images are 80 GB for the 5 fps release, so any future import requires explicit data-import approval and a bounded storage plan.
source_candidates.labels_accessibility_notes: The official page describes annotation files and schemas, but actual labels require annotation downloads/import.
disallowed_or_research_only_subsets: H+M combined partitions until M provenance is cleared
NeuralAnnot/MANO fit targets until explicitly approved
source_candidates.rationale: Large real captured source with explicit H/M split; use would need a narrow human-annotated partition plan before import.

source_candidates.name: Ultralytics hand-keypoints
source_candidates.label_schema: YOLO keypoint format with 21 hand keypoints
license_rights_notes: Documentation states annotations were generated using Google MediaPipe.
YOLO format compatibility and generated MediaPipe provenance are both incompatible with the promoted no-pretrained/no-generated-label lane.
source_candidates.labels_accessibility_notes: Documentation describes labels; no labels were downloaded or imported.
source_candidates.rationale: Generated MediaPipe labels are not human/manual labels and cannot train a promoted scratch landmark detector under the current project constraints.

blockers.description: Plausible manual/human-in-loop sources exist, but none can be imported or used for promoted-lane training without explicit human source/license/data-import approval.
Read-only metadata confirms schemas and partitions, but actual labels were not imported and mostly are not exposed through metadata-only viewer paths.
Hand landmarks can complement the crop route, but current Detector 0 objectness repair remains the immediate no-spend implementation route unless humans approve source/license work.

next_action.reason: The feasibility question is answered: a scratch landmark route is technically plausible from manual/human-in-loop public sources, but the next material step is a human source/license/import approval decision before any source-register or data mutation.
